name: Aurra Kharishma
bio: Aurra Kharishma is an Indonesian model, actress, and beauty queen. She was crowned Miss Grand Indonesia 2020. She represented Indonesia at the Miss Grand International 2020 pageant, where she managed to secure the position of third runner-up.
